United Legal is particularly focused on serious-injury matters and says it puts three lawyers on each medical-negligence case. [www.unitedlegal.com.au](https://www.unitedlegal.com.au/canberra-medical-negligence-lawyers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If it were my case

I'd probably obtain **2–3 initial opinions**, starting with **Liam Casey, Kate Waterford and Chris Gribble**. They're the three lawyers who share the **Preeminent** tier in the current 2026 specialist ranking, and all three are genuinely focused on claimant-side medical negligence rather than simply advertising general personal injury services. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/team/team-member/amy-burr/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/our-team/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: medical-negligence cases can turn heavily on **independent medical expert evidence, causation and ACT limitation periods**, so the "best" lawyer can depend on whether your case involves, for example, a missed diagnosis, surgical error, birth injury, medication error or delayed treatment.

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. surgery, misdiagnosis, birth injury, delayed diagnosis, medication error)** and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this to the **2–3 Canberra lawyers most suited to that particular type of claim**, including their fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements and relevant track record.

One important point: medical-negligence cases can turn heavily on **independent medical expert evidence, causation and ACT limitation periods**, so the "best" lawyer can depend on whether your case involves, for example, a missed diagnosis, surgical error, birth injury, medication error or delayed treatment.

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. surgery, misdiagnosis, birth injury, delayed diagnosis, medication error)** and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this to the **2–3 Canberra lawyers most suited to that particular type of claim**, including their fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements and relevant track record.
